stats.text:
You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle, giving you these benefits.

***Defy Death.*** You have {ref:glossary/advantage} on Death Saving Throws. Moreover, when you roll 18–20 on a {ref:glossary/death-saving-throw}, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

***Heroic Rally.*** At the start of each of your turns, you regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.
